Hi,

I'm sorry about this. Your order Shop···· was for one Hammer DC08 (480 MH/s), and the packing slip in your photo says the same thing. A Thor P2 should never have gone in that box. Our warehouse picked the wrong unit, and your photos make that clear.

I've passed this to the team with your photos and order details. They'll arrange your DC08 and a prepaid return for the Thor P2. The team is offline for the weekend and picks this up Monday at 10am ET. Their answer will come to this email.

Until then, please keep the Thor P2 in its box with everything it came with. You don't need to send anything back yet. The return label will come with the team's reply.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Thanks for the update, I appreciate you looking into this.

Hi,

You're welcome, and thanks for being so patient about it. Your photos and order details are already with the team. Their reply about your DC08 and the return label for the Thor P2 will come to this email after they pick it up on Monday.

Have a good weekend.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
